IMG-HARUKA.name: 遥 全身身份参考
IMG-HARUKA.subject: 遥
IMG-HARUKA.controls: 脸、低马尾、瘦削体形、炭灰色西装外套
IMG-HARUKA.voice: a young woman's calm, clear voice
IMG-HARUKA.prompt: Photorealistic full-body photo of one slim Japanese woman about 28, about 160 cm tall, standing against a plain light grey studio wall, facing the camera, calm neutral expression, shoulder-length black hair in a low ponytail, a charcoal grey blazer over a white shirt, dark trousers, flat shoes. Real unglamorous skin, soft even light, no text, no logo.

adversarial_preflight.worst: 画成半身或裁掉脚，身高比例无法核对
背景出现办公室或其他人
adversarial_preflight.blocked_by: standing against a plain light grey studio wall

adversarial_preflight.worst: 衣服上出现文字或 logo

IMG-MIKAMI.name: 三上 全身身份参考
IMG-MIKAMI.subject: 三上
IMG-MIKAMI.controls: 脸、侧分短发、微胖体形、深蓝西装
IMG-MIKAMI.prompt: Photorealistic full-body photo of one slightly heavy Japanese man about 45, about 175 cm tall, standing against a plain light grey studio wall, facing the camera, a faint superior smile, side-parted short hair, a dark navy suit, a gold wristwatch, black leather shoes. Real skin, soft even light, no text, no logo.

adversarial_preflight.worst: 画成半身或裁掉脚，身高比例无法核对
露出和善的大笑，轻蔑读不出来
手表被画成两块或不见
adversarial_preflight.blocked_by: 验收：左腕只有 1 块金表，数一遍

IMG-PLATE-MEETING.name: 会议室 底板
IMG-PLATE-MEETING.controls: 长桌、投影幕、落地窗白光、白墙
IMG-PLATE-MEETING.prompt: Photorealistic empty location plate, candid 35mm film still, daytime: a corporate meeting room in Tokyo, a standard 2.1 m door near the camera, a long table about 75 cm high running toward a projection screen at the far end, floor-to-ceiling windows with flat white daylight on screen left, a plain white wall with a projector on screen right. No people. No logos, no readable text anywhere. Realistic colors, subtle film grain.

adversarial_preflight.worst: 底板里出现人影或路人
墙上、屏幕上出现可读文字或 logo
adversarial_preflight.blocked_by: No logos, no readable text anywhere.

adversarial_preflight.worst: 门和桌子尺寸失真，人物放进去比例不对
adversarial_preflight.blocked_by: a standard 2.1 m door near the camera
